items.title: Claude Code costs up to $200 a month. Goose does the same thing for free.
items.summary: The artificial intelligence coding revolution comes with a catch: it's expensive. Claude Code , Anthropic's terminal-based AI agent that can write, debug, and deploy code autonomously, has captured the imagination of software developers worldwide. But its pricing — ranging from $20 to $200 per month depending on usage — has sparked a growing rebellion among the very programmers it aims to serve. Now, a free alternati
items.summaryZh: 文章对比了Anthropic的Claude Code与开源项目Goose。由于Claude Code的高昂订阅费用和使用限制，开发者社区转向了由Block开发的开源Agent Goose。Goose支持本地运行，无需云端依赖，且具备与Claude Code相似的编码、调试与部署能力。该现象反映了AI Agent领域在商业化定价与开源替代方案之间的博弈，以及开发者对数据隐私和工具自主权的重视。
